The following events took place in '''17 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[King/Legends|King]] [[Lorac]] and [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Denira]] of [[Velmor/Legends|Velmor]] were [[Death/Legends|killed]] in a plot to place [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial-backed]] [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Anod]] on the throne. The failure to kill and subsequent escape of crown-Prince [[Denid]] leaves [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Regent [[Zelor]] as head of government.<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 49">[[Star Wars (1977) 49|''Star Wars'' (1977) 49]]</ref>
*[[Navik/Legends|Navik the Red]] of the [[Chattza clan/Legends|Chattza Clan]] became ruler of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] and instituted a vicious [[Rodian Clan Wars|purge]] of the rival [[Tetsu Clan]]. Many were killed, including [[Greedo the Elder]].<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
*[[Skee (Rodian)|Skee]] and his family fled to a jungle [[Planet/Legends|planet]] during the Rodian Clan Wars.<ref name="Star Wars Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref><ref name="A Hunter's Fate: Greedo's Tale">{{StoryCite|story=A Hunter's Fate: Greedo's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref>
*Missiles destroyed the royal palace on [[M'haeli/Legends|M'haeli]], creating a power vacuum that lead to Imperial occupation.<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
*The [[Summit Class]] graduated at the [[Galactic Outdoor Survival School/Legends|Galactic Outdoor Survival School]], breaking any previous record.<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>
*[[Thrackan Sal-Solo]] takes a job in the Imperial government of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="NEGC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>
*[[BIX]] and [[Gee Long]] win the [[Drainsweeper/Legends|Drainsweeper]] [[Wikipedia:Relay race|relay race]] event at the [[Roon Colonial Games]] for the second consecutive [[Standard year/Legends|year]].<ref name="The Roon Games">{{DroidsCite|The Roon Games}}</ref>
